## Motivation

What problem does this solve, or what would it enable?

## Proposal

Describe the change you'd like. If it adds a new model architecture, note the
`transformers` config class name (e.g. `Gemma2Config`) and how the block layout
differs from the families already in `arch_config.py`.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one is preferable.

## Additional context

Links to papers, reference implementations, or related issues.
